// A cylindrical fit between a hole and a shaft at a shared nominal diameter,
// with a toleranced deviation for each member.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_tolerance)
type ShaftHoleFit
    implements IValue
{
    NominalDiameter: Length;
    HoleTolerance: Tolerance;
    ShaftTolerance: Tolerance;
    Engagement: FitClass;
}
